_file_note: Notes for app/data/model/mechanism_card.json: where each field came from, who writes and reads it, and the rules it must obey. The field's type, allowed answers, required-ness and column type live with the class in app/models/. Merged by app/repositories/model_catalogue_repository.py.
about: A research mechanism card: how people in a situation reason, distilled from South African qualitative research. Stored one per file in app/data/mechanism_cards/<id>.json. Written by scripts/extract_card.py (draft) and a human reviewer; read by mechanism_card_service (binding, prompt block, citations). Checked by data_model.mechanism_card_problems.
rules: The file name is the card id plus .json.
Cards give reasoning, never figures: claim text, objections, vocabulary and evaluative rules carry no digits.
Everything about a claim sits inside that claim: its rule (needs), its chain and passages, its objections and its vocabulary. Nothing is linked by position.
segment_tags name real persona types (actor_archetype in model/persona.json).
applies_when and every claim needs name facts and answers a persona can have (model/persona.json).
year_range is YYYY or YYYY-YYYY with a plain hyphen, or null when the source gives no dates. Extra wording goes in year_note.
A draft card must pass this model before it is copied into app/data/mechanism_cards.

claims.note: The findings, one self-contained claim each. A claim reaches a persona only when the card applies_when AND its own needs fit.

text.note: The reasoning pattern itself, as the prompt shows it.

needs.note: Who this claim is about, on top of the card applies_when: clauses of persona facts, all facts in a clause must hold, any clause is enough. [] means everyone the card fits. Facts and answers checked against model/persona.json.

passages.note: The source passages this claim came from.

evaluative_rules.note: Decision heuristics from the same chain as this claim.

objections.note: Questions people raise because of this claim.

vocabulary.note: Words people use when reasoning this way. Reaches a prompt only with its claim.

confidence.note: Plain-language strength of the evidence. Shown in the prompt block and receipts.

segment_tags.note: Real persona types only (checked in code against model/persona.json). Used as a fallback binding when a card has no applies_when.

economic_tags.note: Budget tiers the studied population maps to. Absent means class-blind.

topic_tags.note: Subject words a question must mention for the card to reach the prompt (whole-word match).

applies_when.note: Who the card is for: clauses of persona facts; all facts in a clause must hold, any clause is enough. Facts and answers checked against model/persona.json.
